messages:
mike: quick heads-up — planning a small autoscale config change for the eu-west dedicated gpu pool tonight 23:30 UTC. 10% headroom tweak, TTL bump from 30s -> 45s. low-risk but want eyes and smoke owners.

anna: ok, who's owning smoke? i can run the perf smoke suite and watch latency for the first 30m.

lucy: i can handle rollback if something odd shows up. which policy file are we changing? pinging @nate for the diff.

nate: putting the diff here:
```yaml
# infra/autoscale/eu-west-small-bump.yaml
pool: dedicated-eu-west-2
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 16
target_utilization: 0.72   # was 0.8
idle_ttl_seconds: 45    # was 30
```
notes: this reduces burst pressure for short-lived jobs. no model change.

mike: thanks. can we do a canary on slice-A (5% traffic) for 10m then cutover? want a fast rollback plan if queue latency spikes.

anna: yes — i'll run smoke against canary after deploy. smoke commands: `./scripts/run_smoke --pool dedicated-eu-west-2 --canary slice-A`

lucy: rollback plan: revert config, run `kubectl rollout restart ds/gpu-operator -n inference` and priming run to warm KV caches. i'll be ready.

nate: config PR is at https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/4321 — reviewers: @lucy @mike. small change, tag `release:tiny-autoscale-bump`.

mike: timeline: merge at 23:20 UTC, deploy job at 23:25, canary cut at 23:30, observe till 23:40, full roll at 23:45 if green. everyone ok? :clock1030: :thumbsup:

sophia: i'm on metrics watch (SLOs + queue depth). will flag on-call if 99p latency > 1.2x baseline.

lucy: approved the PR, left one nit about comment formatting.

nate: tests passing in CI, infra deploy job queued.

deploy-bot: deploy job `infra-autoscale-deploy/1965432100` started by nate — step: apply-config -> canary-slice -> verify.

anna: canary smoke started (running `run_smoke`), ETA ~3m. posting key metrics in #eng-observability.

sophia: saw a 5% bump in p95 for canary initially, looks like KV warmup. p95 trending back down after 60s. no alert yet.

anna: smoke done — all checks pass. latency and throughput within expected ranges.

mike: green to roll full. proceeding to cutover at 23:45.

deploy-bot: deploy job `infra-autoscale-deploy/1965432100` progressed to full-rollout -> completed.

lucy: post-roll smoke run done. no regressions. rolling back only if we see persistent SLO violations.

nate: updated the runbook with the exact commands I used. link: https://wiki.internal/redwood/infra/autoscale/tiny-bump-1965432100

sophia: closing watch — metrics stable for 10m after full roll. nice and quiet. :trophy:

mike: thanks team — awesome coordination. will schedule a brief retro tomorrow to capture learnings.
